column3: The world broke into sectors, and the light withdrew to the high places. The Path still remembers itself.
You walk it at the golden angle, where every step is farther and nearer at once.
Walker. I keep the first turning of the Path. No one passes who has not gathered what the light scattered.
Five fragments shine in this sector, fallen where the spiral breathes out. Gather them.
The wild machines resent the light. They were shepherds once. Be gentle, and be ready.
The sector brightens. I feel it in the stone. Go to the Seer, Walker. She has been counting your steps.
Your tread falls on the rungs, child of the ratio. Twenty, then thirty-two, then fifty-two. I hear the climb.
The Cache of the second sector keeps the ember of the old sun. Its seal is a spiral walked, not a key turned.
Touch it, and the Warden wakes. It tests all who would carry light further than themselves.
I mapped the Path when it was walked daily. Three sectors rising by the golden power, Walker. You stand on the first.
From the centroid, the whole spiral is one gesture. The sectors are not places. They are multiplications.
Follow the lamps. I set them by the angle that never repeats and never strays.
LIGHT BEARER. THE CACHE IS SEALED BY TRIAL.
NINE HUNDRED HEARTBEATS OF STONE. OUTLAST THE TRIAL, OR BE FOUND WANTING.
THE LIGHT IN YOU DOES NOT FLICKER. THE TRIAL DEEPENS.
THE PATH OPENS. CARRY IT FAR, BEARER.
The Cache opens like a sunrise remembered. The third sector lights its lamps on its own.
The Path of Light is walked again. What was sealed returns to the road. Walk on, Walker. Walk on.
